prompt_markdown: An AI tool says the code below prints `amaraokafor`, because `.strip()` removes every space. Your colleague says it keeps the middle space.
What is the quickest reliable way to settle it?

options.text: Ask the tool whether it is sure.
Run the line, and read the official documentation for `str.strip`.
Go with the colleague, because they are a person.

why: Running it shows `amara okafor`, and the documentation says `strip` only removes characters at the two ends.
